query: SELECT p.name, pv.retailPrice, COUNT(pv.id) as variants FROM products p JOIN productVariants pv ON pv.productId = p.id WHERE p.isActive = 1 GROUP BY p.name, pv.retailPrice ORDER BY p.name;
